reviews.reason: The amended stability supplier distinguishes the normalized matrix variational equation from the vector equation acting on each initial deviation. Statement 1 and Proof 1.1 already use Y(0)=I_(2n) and D_a z u=Y_a u; clause 2 eliminates the two matrix blocks column by column, and clause 3 uses the associated vector equation after translation to the equilibrium. The dimensionless chart, enlarged rho-prime trapping radius, C1 field hypotheses and finite-time remainder estimate satisfy the exact ODE suppliers. No changed supplier use invalidates this carrier or its batch-32 contract.

The amended bounded-central model supplies only framework data and vocabulary here; the singular Coulomb operator is separately realized on H2 by the Coulomb definition and infinitesimal-kinetic-bound theorem, not by the bounded-potential construction. Positive scaling preserves isolated finite-multiplicity spectral points and thus essential spectrum; the outcome-law and flow uses retain their stated domains and choice hypotheses. Units for kappa, gamma, energy and normalized states remain consistent. All batch-58 citation quotes are current, and no affected use needs repair.

The amended central definition fixes reduced admissibility by the lifted H2 domain and reads its equation as a Hilbert-space identity. Proof 1.1 already places every smooth compactly supported radial lift in that domain; 4.1 proves the exact almost-everywhere converse by the squared residual norm, with a pointwise upgrade only for continuous v. Zero u remains a linear identity, and pure preparations require nonzero u and normalization. The existing batch-58 F1 quote includes the amended definition. The units supplier changes no energy or wave-function dimensions used here. No carrier or contract correction is necessary.

The changed line-model generalized-solution vocabulary is not used to infer anything about this interface eigenstate. Statement (a), F1 and Proof 1.1 already specify the glued half-line weak action, not a global L2 second derivative. The current interval/delta definition uses that same realization. Positive scaling with alpha=2mg/hbar² gives E=-mg²/(2hbar²), inverse-length decay m|g|/hbar² and normalized amplitude of dimension length^(-1/2); the nonzero eigenvector and stationary-ray requirements are preserved. The batch-51 citations remain exact. No item or metadata correction is necessary.

The amended central model adds the lifted radial-domain definition and qualifies the zero reference without asserting a continuum threshold for every bounded potential. This remark already describes only smooth compact radial vectors with an almost-everywhere equation, and attributes negative-spectrum completeness and a nonzero continuum to the separate Coulomb results. Its model/observation distinction, excluded effects and uncertainty qualifications for measured inputs are unchanged and accurate. It asserts no new threshold, arbitrary-domain converse or empirical precision, so no carrier or metadata repair is needed.

The line supplier now permits square-integrable generalized solutions and requires the global weak equation. This remark does not exclude all generalized solutions from the state space: it excludes the particular rectangular-barrier scattering solution, whose supplier Proof 5.1 proves nonintegrability from its strictly positive constant transmitted density. Its interface-model and current-ratio descriptions still match the repaired suppliers, with no Born reading for this non-L2 solution and no measurement or statistical inference claimed. No item or contract change is necessary.
